Episode 204. Declaration of War (3)
October 25, 1805.

It's been five days since Ziphl received the declaration of war from the Jekmyeong tribe. The position of the Barmel Federation has been communicated to the entire world, and the only thing left was to confirm whether the Jekmyeong tribe would keep their promise.
Naturally, not only Ziphl, the target of the Jekmyeong tribe's invasion, but all the major powers were on high alert, watching the situation.
In particular, the Barmel Federation had divided their infiltration unit into five, according to the number of Ziphl's first-class magic towers, and completed their infiltration into the Federation.
"It's quite impressive."
Meri said. She was stationed near the first-class magic tower of Lisrit autonomous district, along with the Yona and Tona brothers.

"That's true, sister. I wonder how many warships there are in one magic tower. If this many warships are stationed at every first-class magic tower, it's several times more than during the demon war."
"At least a hundred, I'd say. Approximately fifty each are deployed at the second-class magic towers too. The production capability of those Ziphl bastards is beyond common sense."

"It's probably because of the 'sacred ground' that our youngest mentioned. There isn't much known about the special qualities that space has, so it's likely that it's involved in fleet production. If not, I can't explain this production capability. There should be at least twenty places like the underground construction yard in the Sota desert."
"Heh, the lights from the fleet are beautiful, Meri sister. It makes me feel good as if I'm looking at a night sky full of stars."
"That, Yona sister. They are our enemies. You shouldn't look at them so beautifully."
"What? Say that again, He."
"Ha ha, never mind."
"Yona, Heitona is right."
"If Meri sister says so, then it must be true, hehe. Got it, I'll look at them negatively. Looking at them again, they are unnecessarily dazzling, which is annoying."
"That's right, that's right. Good girl, our Yona. And the Tona guys, you are also knights, so don't belittle others when you look at them, okay?"
"Yep, I will keep that in mind!"
The Tona brothers swallowed their tears inside and forced a smile. Despite becoming heroes of the family and the world after the demon war, their treatment by the brothers hadn't changed much.
In fact, Yona was just teasing the Tona brothers because she found them adorable, and Meri also felt proud of the Tona brothers for not becoming arrogant.
"Sisters, but do you think the Jekmyeong tribe can easily conquer such towers? It seems like there are at least three phantom or ghost squads equivalent to superhumans stationed inside the tower."

"We came here to confirm that, so we need to keep a close eye. Especially here, it is the first-class magic tower farthest from the civilian residential area, so it is likely to be their primary target. There would be no restrictions on attacking it."
From the Barmel Federation's point of view, the best case scenario would be, of course, for Ziphl to counter the Jekmyeong tribe's invasion on an equal footing.
The more both sides get damaged, the greater the benefit for the Barmel Federation.
"If Ziphl is completely defeated, our main enemy could change from Ziphl to the Jekmyeong tribe."

"That could happen, but there is a higher possibility that they will suddenly form an alliance at some point. There are already signs that they have formed an alliance with the remnants of the royal family, so there's no law saying they can't increase their alliances if they are at a disadvantage."
"It will be really difficult if our younger brothers are not liberated from Lafrarosa. Hmm, let's prepare a meal for now."
Just as the Tona brothers were about to enter a pit they had dug beforehand, Meri paused and pointed to the sky.
"Stop, we'll eat later! It has started. A dimensional gate has opened in the sky."
"Damn it, how can it be so big?"
"He? It's beautiful too, it feels like the Milky Way is descending as a whole!"
"They are also our enemies, Yona sister."
The dimensional gate that appeared in the brothers' field of view was even bigger than what they and others who had experienced the Jekmyeong tribe's dimensional gates before had seen.
At a glance, a space big enough for about five hundred warships to comfortably escape was opening in the sky.
Its location was directly above the first-class magic tower of Lisrit.

Meri and her party naturally thought that what would come out of that dimensional gate would be a large fleet. The magic tower was fully prepared and waiting, so it was said that a fleet-to-fleet artillery battle would start immediately.
"What's that?"
However, what came out of the dimensional gate was something unimaginably gigantic that couldn't be called a single warship.
"Is it the Sky Fortress that Ameris mentioned...!"
In the ancient times when Ameris was active, the strength of each power was evaluated not by the number of fleets but by the number of sky fortresses.
The Jekmyeong tribe had the most sky fortresses among them. There were six in total, five castles ruled by the War Kings and one sky fortress dedicated to the God of War.
One of them was now towering over the Lisrit magic tower, displaying its majesty. It was Ussrok Castle, the name of the Sky Fortress operated by War King Gaila.
"It's not comparable to Ram in the Demon War, but it's terrifying... Is it saying that it can handle a first-class magic tower or so with just that one thing without any escort ships?"
Boom, Kwaaaaa...!

The bombardment of the Zephl fleet began as soon as the aerial fortress Uss appeared. A protective shield formed over the entire tower, and the mages who had been on standby released their magic, launching a barrage of magic.
The level of firepower that exploded in an instant was such that even those called Superhumans had to risk their lives to break through alone.
Mary's group lay flat, watching Zephl's response carefully. They were five miles away, but the air was getting hot due to the heat spreading from the tower side.
"The firepower of a 1st class tower is better than we expected, sisters."
"The problem is, it doesn't seem to have any effect on that aerial fortress, already."
The Tona brothers swallowed dryly and said. As they said, the bombardment and magic pouring out from the Rislit tower were having no effect on Uss.
"All fleets! Maximize power. Phantom Squad and Ghost Squad, get out of the magic chain, and prepare to infiltrate the enemy's interior!"

The tower lord shouted as he swung his staff. Phantom Squad and Ghost Squad followed his orders and climbed onto the backs of dragons, but as they got closer, they only confirmed that the shield was intact.
In other words,
Even though the Rislit tower was pouring out all its power as soon as the aerial fortress appeared, it was not threatening the Red Tribe at all.
Moreover, Uss hadn't attacked even once yet. It just floated quietly as if to show off the gap.

"We will give you a chance to surrender. Those who do not want to fight, raise your hands and come out of the tower. White flares will be considered a sign of surrender, so each ship's commanders decide to surrender within one minute."
The voice of Warlord Gaila echoed throughout the tower area.
"We, the Red Tribe, always keep our promises. Those who surrender will immediately be treated the same as civilians."

The dragons carrying the Phantom Squad and Ghost Squad couldn't approach Uss properly. Just once, they barely touched the lower part of the shield, but the enemy's nerve that sprang out like a needle pierced the body of the dragon. It was clearly impossible to infiltrate Uss's interior using dragons and ships.
Only a person capable of tearing the shield alone seemed to be able to infiltrate.
"Tower Lord, we must flee."

Eventually, the Phantom Squad and Ghost Squad, who returned to the tower, suggested an escape to the tower lord. They deeply realized that even with the power of a 1st class tower, a 'battle' with an aerial fortress was not even possible.
A child and an armed knight.

The gap separating a 1st class tower and an aerial fortress could be described that way without any shortage. The Red Fleet, which had raided the 2nd class tower a while ago, would not have been unable to respond to this extent, but the aerial fortress was a completely different dimension.
The Tower Lord immediately accepted the opinion of the Ghost Squad. The Ghost Squad, who had suggested retreating, were survivors of the 2nd class tower raid.
"Damn it...!"
The Tower Lord cursed and shot a signal flare to announce the retreat. The same flares were fired from various parts of the fleet.
"If you wanted to live, you should have followed my instructions and fired a white flare. How foolish."
After Gaila's words, the bottom of Uss opened up. The Zephl fleet turned its head, and the Tower Lord, Phantom Squad, and Ghost Squad had already boarded a small ship and started flying.
The only remaining goal for the Rislit tower was to survive and report the power of the aerial fortress to the upper level.
Gaila had no intention of even allowing that.
"Shimart, fire."
Gaila said, pouring blood into a glass. Beyond the bridge, the image of humans running away meaninglessly could be seen.
"Gaila, I think it's better to acquire part of the tower and analyze it than to completely eliminate it."
"Even if it's a low-tech structure, do we really need to do that?"
"We need to. Even if it's a lower tech, there may be elements that can threaten us. What was the price we paid for underestimating the Rune Kandel and Barmel alliances?"

"Hmm... Well, if Shimart says so, it must be. Then break the tower appropriately and collect it, and eliminate everything else. This time, too, we only take the blood of those who survived the aftermath of the shelling."
"Fire!"
A huge red sphere was formed at the bottom of Uss. Just that alone distorted the space around the tower, and some mages and dragons were pulled into the sphere and disappeared without a trace.
Like corn on the cob, the tower was breaking into pieces. The broken fragments were being absorbed into the upper part of Uss.

Soon after the tower was collected, the main cannon fired by Uss was not a simple linear form. Centered on a pillar-like red nerve that devastated the area, tentacle-like nerves came out and were hitting the fleeing Zephl.
The fleeing tower personnel couldn't resist the shelling even once, and were simply slaughtered.
Mary and her party could not help but shiver at the sight.
"...The Red Tribe didn't just hit here today, I'm not sure what the situation is on the other side. But if every battle is like this, there's no hope for Zephl."
